notes.content: Fixed several small bugs, updated user interface, added 6 new illustrated/fully narrated stories, with more on the way!

notes.title: Black Screen Fix!
notes.content: Major Update, the game has been unpackaged! We recommend reinstalling the game to ensure a good experience! Also, be sure to check out our new site at sprottlearning.com/kids. Lots of free activities for kids, free learning videos and songs, and free materials for parents and teachers!

notes.title: One Year Anniversary FREE DLC
notes.content:
We're excited to announce a major update and free DLC for "My Kindergarten Learning Adventure," available now on the Steam Store!

This update introduces a range of new features and enhancements designed to provide even more fun and engaging learning experiences for young learners. From new interactive mini-games to updated graphics and animations, there's something for everyone in this exciting new release.

Explore the new "Coloring Books" area where your child can further learn about numbers and the alphabet. The new "Read a Book" offers fun, original and illustrated stories that teach children about counting, shapes, and much more!

With the new free DLC, your child can explore a new world of learning with additional content focused on math, reading, and critical thinking. Featuring engaging activities that encourage children to practice counting, reading comprehension, and problem-solving, this DLC offers even more ways to make learning fun and engaging.

We are also rolling out updates to the game's graphics and voice, making it even more visually appealing and engaging for young learners. And with improved user interface and performance optimizations, "My Kindergarten Learning Adventure" is now even more accessible and easy to use.

Don't miss out on this exciting new update and free DLC for "My Kindergarten Learning Adventure." Download it now on Steam and help your child embark on a fun and educational journey today!
Fixed an error that displayed a number when going into the Progress Report, and added some additional dialogue
